_comment: Curated raw-material purchase manifest for scripts/whistlebird_migration.py. 'clean' records are real order-confirmation emails, imported as dated receipts without allocation to a specific consuming batch (same policy as legacy raw materials, WB-018): botanicals from jill@alembics.co.nz (post-legacy-cutoff, 2025-05-13 onward) and, since 2026-09-18, every Neutral grain spirit receipt ever bought from spirits@southerngrainspirits.co.nz (2023-04-24 onward -- superseding the legacy purchases_gns table as the sole NGS source; see whistlebird_replay_timeline._ngs_allocations, which pools these instead of reading purchases_gns, so the replay no longer needs legacy-DB access for NGS). 'resolved_by_context' records have no email or database purchase evidence -- each is sized to exactly the named batch's own 2x-multiplied recipe requirement and dated 3 days before that batch's maceration date; supplier per the founder's 2026-09-14 supplier list (updated same day to add Szechuan pepper -> Davis Trading and Green tea -> Countdown/Woolworths), not verified against a receipt. Where a later physical lot label establishes the full receipt, `purchase_quantity` is the quantity created in inventory while `quantity` remains the exact amount consumed by the named VAT. Founder-confirmed 2026-09-14: each distillation runs two multi-shot concentrates into one VAT, so real per-batch consumption is 2x the founder's stated per-shot recipe quantity.
excluded_from_recipe: Fresh/foraged items never tracked as purchases, per founder (2026-09-14): Wildflower's Lemon juice, Grapefruit (pink) juice, Lemon peel; Solstice's Kawakawa leaf, fresh orange peel, fresh orange juice.

clean_records.source: supplier lot label: date positioned after the 2026-expiry lot and before the next replay event
